facts.text: The Sojourner rover on Mars traveled at a top speed of 1 centimeter per second to ensure hazard-detection lasers could stop the rover before encountering dangerous drop-offs.
Curiosity's aluminum wheels feature puncture patterns that spell 'JPL' in Morse code (.--- .--. .-..), which imprint in the Martian regolith to calculate wheel slip by visual odometry.
Because the Martian atmosphere is less than 1% the density of Earth's at sea level, the Ingenuity helicopter spun its carbon-fiber composite rotors at over 2,400 RPM to generate aerodynamic lift.
The Apollo laser retroreflectors left on the Moon require zero electrical power and continue reflecting laser pulses back to Earth observatories, proving the Moon recedes by 3.8 centimeters annually.
The InSight lander's ultra-sensitive SEIS seismometer on Mars was enclosed under a vacuum sphere beneath a thermal shield capable of measuring vibrations smaller than the diameter of an atom.
